faqs.a:
The following words, terms, and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meaning ascribed to them in this section, unless the context clearly indicates a different
               meaning:
Abandoned, lost,
or
unclaimed property
means any item or items that come into the possession of the police department or
               the city and for which the custodian is unable to determine an owner, or which is
               otherwise deemed forfeited.
City
means the City of Arvada, Colorado.
Custodian
means the chief of police or designee thereof who is assigned to act as the holder
               of all property coming into the possession of the police department or the city, whether
               it is lost, abandoned, forfeited, seized, confiscated, or recovered stolen property.
               Nothing in this article shall be held to require the chief to take possession of or
               make a disposition of any property the possession or disposition of which is otherwise
               provided for in this Code.
Days
means calendar days.
Director
means the director of finance for the city or designee thereof.
Evidence
means an item or material that has probative value in either tending to prove or
               disprove a material fact in a criminal or civil matter.
Owner
means a person or entity, including a corporation, partnership, association, governmental
               entity other than the city, or a duly authorized legal representative of same, which
               has a legal or equitable interest in property subject to this article.
Police department
means the Arvada Police Department.
Policy
means a city policy or procedure, or a police department rule, procedure, or guideline.
Property
or
item
means tangible personal property and, for purposes of the administration of this
               article, includes cash, checks, securities, and gift cards or certificates.
(
Ord. No. 4238, § 1, 12-6-2010
)
